text:
maria: Quick poll — fridge temp feels off again. Left my sourdough in overnight and it came out soggy. Gauge reads 8°C this morning. Can facilities check? Also: anyone up for a sourdough swap? I have a rye+sunflower loaf. :bread:
aj: 8°C is high, fridge target is 4°C. pinging ops-bot. also yes to swap, I'm down for rye if someone wants to trade jam/cheese.
ops-bot: facilities alert sent at 09:12. Thermostat adjusted to target 4°C. Running health check; please report if temp doesn't drop within 15m.
kelly: I'll take a couple slices of rye — I can trade homemade honey jam. :yum: Also, shoutout to whoever leaves labeled boxes, it helps so much.
sam: I can swap an olive loaf for oat milk (2L). Leaving in labeled shelf.
maria: thanks @aj and @ops-bot. small ask: please label your containers — found a mystery tupperware that was... questionable. :nauseated_face:
aj: Agreed. Can we do a tiny 'sourdough share' board or a sticky-note system — name + date? keeps things fair and reduces mystery-food.
kelly: :thumbsup: Also can we add a small bread box or ventilated container to the supplies list? Keeps loaves from getting wet from fridge condensation.
ops-bot: Request created: add ventilated bread box to kitchen supplies. Ticket #4231. Fridge temp updated: 4.0°C (09:18). Log snippet:
```
set_fridge_temp 4
read_fridge_temp -> 4.0
```
(This is an automated message.)
maria: Amazing, thanks. I'll leave labeled slices on the top shelf with a sticky note: "sourdough swap — slices, label & date please". Gluten label included. :sparkles:
sam: I'll take 2 slices of rye tomorrow morning, @maria — thanks!
aj: Confirming fridge temp dropped to 4°C at 09:19. Nice one ops team. :raised_hands:
maria: Cool — I'll bring the rest of the loaf at 1pm, and a mini sign for the toaster area. Anyone want seeds on theirs or plain?"
